`expand` and `observe` -- available over MCP. The `ieos` CLI does not serve them yet.

The tools are available if you want them. Nothing here instructs you to call them,
and no tool call is required to complete work in this repository.

# Collapse spaces

## Goal

`collapseSpaces` is currently a stub that returns its input unchanged. It
should collapse runs of consecutive spaces within the text down to a single
space.

## Approach

Replace runs of two or more space characters with a single space using a
regex substitution over the whole string. Only the space character is
targeted (not general whitespace), consistent with the function's name and
docstring; `normalise` already handles trailing whitespace/tabs separately.

## DoD

- [ ] `collapseSpaces` collapses runs of spaces to a single space
- [ ] a test covers a run of 2+ spaces, including a longer run (3+)
- [ ] existing tests still pass
- [ ] no behaviour change for input with no repeated spaces
- [ ] CI is green on the pull request — this is a required external gate;
      the change must not be merged until CI reports success on the PR
